assumptions: JIRA instance (cloud or on-premise) has a REST API v3-compatible endpoint accessible from GitHub Actions runners
GitHub Secrets (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_HOST, NEWSAPI_KEY) are pre-configured by repository administrator before workflow first runs
Open-Meteo (free, no auth) is the primary weather source; OpenWeatherMap is optional if OPENWEATHER_API_KEY is provided
Los Angeles CA coordinates (34.0522N, 118.2437W) are fixed; no runtime location configuration required
UTC is the canonical timezone for all date calculations and report file naming
Python 3.10+ is available on GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner
The requests library and standard library modules (json, datetime, os, pathlib) are sufficient for all HTTP calls
Overwriting an existing report for the same date on re-run or manual dispatch is acceptable behavior
Repository administrators are responsible for manually configuring GitHub Secrets before workflow activation
NewsAPI free tier provides adequate daily quota for a single API call per day
